about: Fixtures for pi-mac --vision (MAC-01). Photos are CC0 downloads, byte-identical to the Wikimedia Commons 960px thumbnails named in `download`; everything else is drawn by scripts/make-vision-fixtures.swift. Boxes are image pixels, top-left origin, {x, y, width, height}. Every expected box was measured WITHOUT Vision (see `measured`), so the tests compare Vision against an independent reference rather than against itself.

cat.jpg.license: CC0 1.0 (photo by Sarah Dorweiler, published on Unsplash, via Wikimedia Commons)

subject.name: the cat
subject.measured: pixels darker than mean(RGB) 150 above the chair legs (y < 555), trimmed to the 0.2nd-99.8th percentiles; excludes the white toy mouse Vision lifts with the cat

apples.jpg.measured: green chroma (G > 30 and G - max(R, B) > 8), one box per column cluster, 0.1st-99.9th percentiles; the darkest shadowed rim of the right apple falls under the threshold, so its box is ~20 px short on the right

nearMiss.note: on the dark wall ~11 px left of the middle apple's rim: background as tapped, the middle apple with the radius

cat-rotated.jpg.note: cat.jpg's pixels stored a quarter turn counter-clockwise with EXIF orientation 6 (rotate 90° clockwise to display): it displays exactly like cat.jpg, so results must match cat.jpg's display coordinates

sign-misspelt.png.note: the misspelling an OCR check must report; read with correction off
